spanish: Y acercó la ofrenda, y llenó su palma desde ella, e hizo humear sobre el altar, aparte del holocausto de la mañana.
grammarChanges: minjá → ofrenda (הַמִּנְחָה, H4503, is a common noun; rendered in Spanish instead of left as the untranslated lemma, per cited fail finding).
de holocausto → del holocausto (עֹלַת הַבֹּקֶר carries a definite construct via the article on הַבֹּקֶר; added the Spanish definite article to match, per cited warn finding).
